note: Metadata for the articles in this folder. 'status': 'active' articles are indexed; 'draft' articles are not, until someone reviews and activates them. 'version' is NOT written here: the loader derives it from the article's content, so it can never go stale. 'last_reviewed' and 'effective_date' are null because no review has been recorded; fill them in when a reviewer signs an article off. These articles are general banking references written for the project, not any bank's official terms. Phase 3A provenance: 'verification' is 'unverified' for every article because no one has verified them against a source; 'source_reference' is null because they were authored for the project, not copied from a source. None of them states a rate, fee, limit or timing, so none is 'time_sensitive'. An article that does state such a figure must set 'time_sensitive': true, and is then indexed only once 'verification' is 'verified' and 'last_reviewed' is set; give it 'effective_until' when the figure has an end date. 'unlisted': 'skip' means a markdown file not listed below is NOT indexed: adding it here is the review step. See app/knowledge/loader.py.
